analysis_type: Post-hoc comparison of three internal and seven external same-point bound decompositions; no refitting or new experiment

comparison_rule.available_points: 369 internal plus 532 external equals 901 descriptive available points, not a universal sample or probability estimate
comparison_rule.scope_separation: Retain two internal rooted unavailable folds separately from 254 external unavailable points; do not create a combined success rate
comparison_rule.classification: Reuse the already frozen 0.5 dominance classifications without retuning
comparison_rule.validation: Require zero source identity mismatches and zero undefined zero bounds in both inputs
comparison_rule.datasets: Preserve Hahn1, Thurber, Kirby2, Filip, MGH17, Gauss1, Misra1a, Chwirut1, ENSO and Roszman1 as separate distributions
comparison_rule.related_dataset_scope: Chwirut1 was not used in previous region design, but shares its study and native model family with Chwirut2; it is not an independent model-family or laboratory replication test
comparison_rule.periodic_candidate_scope: The ENSO candidate is not the native ENSO nine-parameter Fourier model; its 131 tighter ellipsoid/box pairs are a subset and not a probability or whole-dataset claim
comparison_rule.roszman1_candidate_scope: The Roszman1 cubic/cubic candidate is not the native four-parameter arctangent model; its five available points occur only in fold 2, are not a 25-point probability coverage claim and are not an independent physical experiment
comparison_rule.previous_comparison: Preserve exports/internal-external-bound-comparison.json and v2, v3, v4 versions and all their figures unchanged

prohibitions: No universal internal-versus-external ranking or combined success rate
No erasure of internal rooted folds, external unavailable points, Chwirut1/Chwirut2 relatedness or ENSO candidate scope
No native-arctangent-model, independent-physical-experiment or whole-Roszman1 coverage claim
No probability, variance-decomposition or physical-mechanism interpretation of arithmetic shares
